subject: Maths
title: Year 7 Maths: Half-term 1 (Place value, rounding and negative numbers)

questions.question: Write 3 040 506 in words.
options: Three million, four thousand, five hundred and six
Three hundred and four thousand, five hundred and six
Three million, forty thousand, five hundred and six
Three million, four hundred thousand, fifty-six
questions.answer: Three million, forty thousand, five hundred and six
questions.explanation: 3 040 506 = 3 millions, 0 hundred-thousands, 4 ten-thousands (40 thousand), 0 thousands, 5 hundreds, 0 tens, 6 ones.

questions.question: Work out $3.6 \times 100$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying by 100 moves every digit two places to the left: 360.

questions.question: Work out $45 \div 1000$.
questions.explanation: Dividing by 1000 moves every digit three places to the right: 0.045.

questions.question: Round 46 872 to the nearest thousand.
questions.explanation: The hundreds digit is 8 (5 or more), so round up to 47 000.

questions.question: Round 0.04718 to 2 significant figures.
questions.explanation: The first significant figure is 4, the second is 7. The next digit is 1, so it stays 0.047.

questions.question: Estimate $49.7 \times 6.1$ by rounding each number to 1 significant figure.
Work out $-7 + 3$.
questions.explanation: Start at $-7$ and move 3 to the right: $-4$.

questions.question: Work out $2 - (-5)$.
questions.explanation: Subtracting a negative is the same as adding: $2 + 5 = 7$.

questions.question: Work out $-24 \div -6$.
questions.explanation: Same signs give a positive answer: $24 \div 6 = 4$.

questions.question: At 6 am the temperature was $-3$°C. By 2 pm it was 8°C. By how much did it rise?
questions.explanation: From $-3$ up to 0 is 3, then up to 8 is 8 more: $3 + 8 = 11$°C.
